# HaproID – Free Professional Profile


**HaproID**is a **digital identity platform** that allows everyone to create their own **unique online profile**. It's not just for students, but also suitable for **job seekers, professionals, and creators.**


---

## 🌐What is HaproID?
HaproID is your **digital identity.** 
It lets you showcase your professional and personal details in a single link.


### These include:
- Your name  
- profile photo 
- Skills / Expertise  
- Social Media Links (LinkedIn, Instagram, GitHub, YouTube etc.)  
- Contact Details  
- Resume / CV (optional)  
- Projects / Portfolio  

---
---
## 🎯 फायदे (Benefits)

1. **One-link profile** – No need to share the link again and again.
2. **SEO-friendly** – Easily visible in Google search.  
3. **Verified & Professional** – trusted digital identity  
4. **Free & Simple** – Prepare without website or coding knowledge. 
5. **All-in-one** –For students, job seekers, creators all.
^. **Haproid_Name** –Pro-[first-name]-[serial-number] .

---

## 🛠️ How to create HaproID?
1. [HaproID Create Link](https://haproid.netlify.app/)go to. 
2. Your **username** Pro-[first-name]-[serial-number]
3. Fill profile details
4. Share your link and increase your digital presence.
---

## 🔗 Example

Unique HaproID URLs का format: Pro-[first-name]-[serial-number]

# 🚀 HAPROVEN — Tech Community

--- ## 🖼️ Haproven Frame

The People Behind Haproven

Haproven Frame recognizes the developers, builders, and contributors helping Haproven grow through open-source collaboration.

👆 Click a profile photo to visit that contributor's GitHub profile.

--- ## 💡 About HAPROVEN **HAPROVEN** is a technology community for developers, students, creators, and technology enthusiasts. We bring people together to **learn, build, collaborate, and innovate** through real-world projects, hackathons, events, open-source development, and technology initiatives. ### 🎯 Our Focus * 🏆 Hackathons * 💻 Real-world Projects * 🎯 Technology Events * 🌱 Open Source * 🤝 Developer Collaboration * 🚀 Learning & Innovation --- ## 🌐 HAPROVEN Ecosystem **HaproID** • **HaproShow** • **HaproLearn** • **HaproAPI** • **HaproFun** Our ecosystem is built to help developers **create profiles, showcase projects, learn technologies, explore developer tools, and participate in community activities.** --- ## 💭 Have an Idea for HAPROVEN? We want to hear from you. If you have an idea, improvement, event concept, project suggestion, feature request, or anything related to Haproven, you can share it with us. 📁 **Suggestions folder:** [`suggestions/`](./suggestions/) You can suggest things like: * 💡 New Haproven features * 🛠️ Website improvements * 🏆 Hackathon ideas * 🎯 Event ideas * 💻 Project ideas * 🌐 New ecosystem services * 🤝 Community activities * 📚 Learning initiatives * 🎨 UI/UX improvements * 🚀 Any useful idea related to Haproven **No idea is too small if it can help the community grow.** --- ## 🪪 Want Your Profile in the HAPROVEN Community? If you are a developer, contributor, builder, or active community member and want your GitHub profile to become part of the Haproven community, we'd love to see you contribute. Start by: 1. ⭐ Exploring Haproven 2. 💻 Contributing to a project 3. 💡 Sharing a useful suggestion 4. 🤝 Participating in community activities 5. 🚀 Building something with Haproven Your contributions help the community grow — and your profile can become part of that journey. --- ## 🤝 How You Can Contribute You don't need to be an expert. You can contribute through: **Code** → Build & improve projects **Ideas** → Suggest useful improvements **Design** → Improve UI/UX **Documentation** → Improve guides & information **Events** → Help organize community activities **Feedback** → Tell us what can be better Every useful contribution matters. --- ## 🔐 Suggestions & Privacy The `suggestions/` folder is intended for **private suggestions and internal discussion**. Please do **not** submit: * Passwords * API keys * Personal documents * Private credentials * Sensitive personal information Only share information that is appropriate for the Haproven team to review. --- ## 🔗 Connect With HAPROVEN

🌐 Website • 💻 GitHub • 📸 Instagram • ▶️ YouTube

---

### 🚀 HAPROVEN Where Ideas Get Proven.

readme:
# vishnupur SMR (Sitamarhi)

**vishnupur (bishnupur) SMR** विष्णुपुर, सीतामढ़ी, बिहार (843324) के लिए बनाया गया एक ओपन-सोर्स वेब एप्लिकेशन है। इसका उद्देश्य गाँव की डिजिटल पहचान बनाना और गाँव से जुड़ी महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी को एक ही स्थान पर उपलब्ध कराना है।

इस वेब-ऐप को इंस्टॉल करने के बाद उपयोगकर्ता गाँव से संबंधित उपयोगी और समय-समय पर अपडेट होने वाली जानकारी आसानी से देख सकेंगे।

##  विष्णुपुर SMR क्या है?

विष्णुपुर SMR एक सामुदायिक डिजिटल सूचना मंच (Digital Information Platform) है, जिसका उद्देश्य गाँव के इतिहास, संस्कृति, विकास और सामुदायिक गतिविधियों को सुरक्षित रखना तथा सभी तक पहुँचाना है।

यह केवल एक वेबसाइट नहीं, बल्कि विष्णुपुर गाँव का डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड तैयार करने का एक दीर्घकालिक प्रयास है।

##  इसमें क्या-क्या जानकारी मिलेगी?

* 🏛️ गाँव का इतिहास और विरासत
* 🗺️ गाँव की सामान्य एवं प्रशासनिक जानकारी
* 🏫 स्कूलों और शैक्षणिक संस्थानों की जानकारी
* 🛕 मंदिरों और धार्मिक स्थलों की जानकारी
* 📍 महत्वपूर्ण एवं पर्यटन स्थलों की जानकारी
* 🏪 गाँव की दुकानों और स्थानीय व्यवसायों की जानकारी
* 👨‍💼 वर्तमान मुखिया एवं अन्य जनप्रतिनिधियों/अधिकारियों की जानकारी
* 📞 आवश्यक संपर्क विवरण
* 📰 गाँव से जुड़े समाचार और अपडेट
* 🎉 दुर्गा पूजा, सरस्वती पूजा, छठ पूजा तथा अन्य स्थानीय त्योहारों की जानकारी
* 🏫 स्कूल कार्यक्रमों और सामुदायिक गतिविधियों का विवरण
* 📅 आगामी कार्यक्रमों की पूरी जानकारी
* 💰 कार्यक्रमों में प्राप्त चंदा और हुए खर्च का विवरण (यदि आयोजकों द्वारा सार्वजनिक किया जाए)
* 📸 गाँव की तस्वीरें, यादें और ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड
* 🚧 गाँव में होने वाले विकास कार्यों और भविष्य की योजनाओं की जानकारी
* 💻 समुदाय द्वारा ओपन-सोर्स योगदान की सुविधा

##  हमारा उद्देश्य

हमारा लक्ष्य एक ऐसा विश्वसनीय डिजिटल मंच तैयार करना है, जहाँ विष्णुपुर का प्रत्येक निवासी गाँव से जुड़ी सही और उपयोगी जानकारी प्राप्त कर सके।

साथ ही, सामुदायिक कार्यक्रमों, दान राशि और खर्च से संबंधित जानकारी को पारदर्शी तरीके से प्रस्तुत कर गाँव में जवाबदेही और विश्वास को बढ़ावा देना भी इस परियोजना का उद्देश्य है।

## 🤝 योगदान करें

यह एक ओपन-सोर्स प्रोजेक्ट है। यदि आप इस परियोजना में योगदान देना चाहते हैं, तो आप:

* नई जानकारी साझा कर सकते हैं,
* पुरानी या गलत जानकारी को सुधार सकते हैं,
* कोड में सुधार कर सकते हैं,
* नए सुझाव दे सकते हैं,
* तस्वीरें और ऐतिहासिक जानकारी उपलब्ध करा सकते हैं।

आपका छोटा-सा योगदान भी इस मंच को और बेहतर बनाने में मदद करेगा।

# 🚀 HaproShow **HaproShow** is a project showcase platform by **Haproven** where developers, students, and creators can showcase, discover, and share their projects. > **Show your project. Share your ideas. Get discovered.** --- ## ✨ About HaproShow HaproShow is built to give projects a dedicated space on the web. Creators can present their projects with important details such as: * 📌 Project name and description * 👤 Project creator * 🛠️ Technologies used * 🖼️ Project screenshots * 🔗 Live demo * 💻 Source code / GitHub repository * 🏷️ Project category * 📅 Project information The goal is to make it easier for people to **discover projects, explore ideas, and connect with creators**. --- ## 🌐 Haproven Ecosystem HaproShow is part of the **Haproven** ecosystem. | Platform | Purpose | | ----------------- | -------------------------------- | | 🚀 **Haproven** | Technology & developer community | | 👤 **HaproID** | Developer and creator profiles | | 🎨 **HaproShow** | Project showcase | | 📚 **HaproLearn** | Learning & educational resources | | 🔌 **HaproAPI** | APIs and developer services | | 🎮 **HaproFun** | Fun & interactive projects | --- ## 🎯 Goals HaproShow aims to: * Help creators showcase their work * Make projects easier to discover * Encourage students and developers to build * Give projects a professional online presence * Connect creators with the wider tech community * Promote innovation and real-world projects --- ## 🛠️ Features ### Project Showcase Present projects with a clean and structured project page. ### Creator Profiles Connect projects with their creators through HaproID. ### Project Discovery Browse and discover projects created by members of the community. ### Live Demo Provide a direct link to try the project. ### Source Code Link projects to their GitHub repositories. ### Categories & Technologies Organize projects by category and technology. --- ## 🏗️ Project Structure ```text haproShow/ ├── assets/ ├── css/ ├── js/ ├── images/ ├── index.html ├── README.md └── ... ``` > The project structure may change as HaproShow evolves. --- ## 🚀 Getting Started Clone the repository: ```bash git clone https://github.com/haproven/haproShow.git ``` Go to the project directory: ```bash cd haproShow ``` Then open the project in your preferred code editor and run it using your local development environment. --- ## 🤝 Contributing Contributions are welcome! If you have an idea, improvement, bug fix, or feature proposal: 1. Fork the repository 2. Create a new branch 3. Make your changes 4. Commit your changes 5. Push the branch 6. Open a Pull Request --- ## 📌 Future Plans Some planned improvements may include: * 🔎 Advanced project search * 🏷️ Technology and category filters * ⭐ Featured projects * ❤️ Project likes * 📊 Project statistics * 👤 Creator profiles * 🔗 HaproID integration * 📱 Improved mobile experience * 🌐 Public project pages --- ## 📄 License This project is developed and maintained by **Haproven**. --- ## 🌟 Haproven **HaproShow** is a part of the Haproven ecosystem, built to help people **transform ideas into real-world solutions**. **Show your work. Share your ideas. Build something meaningful.** --- ### 🔗 Links * **Haproven:** https://haproven.netlify.app * **HaproShow:** https://github.com/haproven/haproShow ---

Made with ❤️ by Haproven
